name: Restaurant Menu
description: Menu sections and dishes with prices, photos and diet tags, rendered by an elegant Puck block. Optional simple online ordering: client-side cart, order saved server-side and handed off to WhatsApp with a prebuilt summary.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read menu sections, dishes and incoming orders.
Create/update menu sections and dishes, and store incoming orders.
Read the restaurant configuration (currency, ordering toggle, WhatsApp number, delivery fee, labels).
Save the restaurant configuration from the admin page.
Public menu/config/order endpoints and the admin CRUD endpoints.
Add the Restaurante entry to the admin sidebar.
Notify the configured email address when a new order arrives (optional, degrades gracefully).
